items.title: The homepage is heavy on a phone
items.detail: The homepage is about 3.8 MB on a phone, mostly photos, where fast sites stay under 3 MB.
items.fix: Resize and compress the photos (and load the ones further down only when needed), so the page opens fast on cell data.
